contributions.basis: schedule-total == page-subtotal == BoxB == BoxC, all a slashed-zero glyph
contributions.detail: EMPTY SCHEDULE, honestly zero. Schedule A carries a single slashed-zero glyph on the first ruled line and nothing else; 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received' each carry a slashed zero, as do Box A, Box B and Box C. Per the zero-glyph ruling a slashed zero DENOTES 0, so those anchors are '0' with the glyph noted; zero rows emitted. Box B == Box C so period and year-to-date coincide; scope cumulative. Box F and the Balance-at-Close box are left BLANK by the filer (recorded as empty strings, NOT as zero).

expenditures.detail: 14 rows sum to exactly 4,891.63 = the printed 'Subtotal for this page' (written '$ 4 891.63', with a space where the thousands comma would be) = 'Total Expenditures Made $ 4,891.63' = Box D (this period) = Box E (year to date). Box D == Box E so period and YTD coincide; scope cumulative. The closing sum also settles the two hardest handwritten figures on the sheet: line 8 as 32.60 and line 13 as 1946.46 (both written with 6-glyphs that read as 'l0'/'le' at page scale).

gates.page_subtotal: p2 (Schedule A): no rows; printed subtotal and total are both slashed zeros, consistent with the empty schedule. p3 (Schedule B): 14 rows sum 4,891.63 = printed subtotal 4,891.63 = printed 'Total Expenditures Made' 4,891.63. Gates EXACTLY.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2 reports geometry ok with 15 ruled bands, only the first carrying ink (a single slashed zero, not a transaction) - 0 rows emitted. rowbands.py p3 returns geometry_status 'gaps' (the sheet is skewed 1.4 degrees and one band merges two rows), so it is NOT treated as an oracle: rows were counted by INK - 14 inked lines - and the amount-row pitch was measured directly from the amount column (row 1 centre 21.70% of page height, row 7 47.40%, row 14 78.00%) and then PROVEN by probe crops. On this form the amount is written LOW in its row, sitting across the rule below its own date/vendor text, which is why the naive band index does not line up with the ink.
gates.geometry_proof: p3: a probe at the computed row-1 amount box renders '170.00'; a probe at the computed row-7 box renders '54.44' (mid-page check that the pitch has not drifted); a probe at the computed row-14 box renders '30.00'; a probe one pitch BELOW row 14 renders EMPTY. p2: a full-width crop of the first ruled line renders the lone slashed-zero glyph with the amount column empty.
gates.balance_chain: THE CHAIN CANNOT BE CLOSED FROM THIS FORM, and that is the filer's doing, not a gap in reading: Box A = 0 (slashed zero) and Box B = 0 (slashed zero), but Box F (Subtotal before Expenditures) and 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period' are both left ENTIRELY BLANK. Box D = Box E = 4,891.63. Taken at face value the filing reports 4,891.63 of expenditures against ZERO reported contributions and states no closing balance; no figure is computed or supplied here to fill those two blanks. Only one Gunnell filing is in this chunk (the county also holds '2024_cc_2024_General_Nolan_P_Gunnell.pdf', not in this chunk and not consulted), so no cross-filing chain was run.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crops: p3 amount column full height, p3 date column full height, p3 extreme-left-margin strip for rows 8-14 (to see what survives the scan's clipped edge), p3 probe crops at rows 1 / 7 / 14 and one pitch below row 14, p2 first-line full-width crop.
notes: Office line INSIDE the form reads 'County Council' - a COUNTY office, in scope; agrees with the chunk file, as does the candidate name 'Nolan P. Gunnell'. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' is marked and the amendment question is answered 'No'; the signature date is 6-11-2024 and pages 2-4 carry 'Date of Report 6-11-2024', but the Date-of-Report and Page boxes on the COVER are left blank - noted, not filled. This cover is the five-option variant (it offers a primary box), unlike the three-option variant used by the other 2024 filings in this chunk. SCAN DEFECT THAT COSTS DATA: the left edge of Schedule B (page 3) is CUT OFF in the scan. Rows 9-12 keep a legible month digit at the very edge; rows 13 and 14 retain only '2024' in the date cell, with the month and day not present in the image at all - those two dates are left BLANK and flagged rather than guessed, and row 12's clipped month is flagged too. A human with the paper original could recover all three. Row 8's date carries two competing day figures ('12' written above '29') and is also left blank. NONE of these affects the money: every amount is legible and the page sums exactly. The candidate's home street address, phone and email are printed in the clear on the cover and are DISCARDED at read time. Schedule A is an honest EMPTY SCHEDULE (a slashed zero), not an untranscribed side.
